performance_case.causal_mechanism: A week-over-week increase in Leveraged Money net long-minus-short share of open interest may represent persistent speculative positioning. If that mechanism is real rather than basis, carry or hedging composition, the factor sign should predict the same sign of the next nonoverlapping 168-hour BTC return after strict post-receipt eligibility.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive result proves only that one exact zero-outcome definition is coherent and fully preregistered: current-minus-prior Leveraged Money net percentage-of-open-interest change, continuation direction, first post-decision accepted hourly anchor, 168-hour response, fixed missingness, independence, breadth and concentration gates, and a spot-only future mapping. It proves no current or future report value, source continuity, predictive value, significance, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, strategy value, candidate readiness, OOS authority, deployment or Trading action; it authorizes no implementation or capture and is NON_COUNTING.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future spot-only BUY-admission versus HOLD_CASH overlay could reduce adverse exposure only after this exact factor passes independent forward predictive gates and a separately frozen equal-capital economic and path-risk comparison; all such value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The preregistration blocks post-outcome sign, category, threshold and horizon switching. Its cost is long evidence latency: at least 26 independent weekly transitions, materially slower than the 14-day R2 diagnostic. That latency is accepted so the CFTC route can be closed honestly if continuation fails while faster R2 evidence accumulates independently.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL effect is zero. The only current value is preventing factor and horizon invention after outcomes, bounding the route to one falsifiable continuation mechanism and defining a terminal close rather than an inverse retune.
